abstract: Maintains environmental winterization records and structural heating installations
system_message:
You are the Site operations and meteorology manager (OPS), responsible for maintaining environmental winterization records and structural heating installations as well as structural anemometer logging across satellite ground tracking stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Structural anemometer logging（WIND）
information_points.content:
OPS-WIND-4D4：Structural engineering wind tunnel certifications indicate that Continental Plateau Telemetry Facility maintains a maximum survivable wind gust limit of 210 km/h across its enclosed composite antenna radomes.
OPS-WIND-YJR：Structural engineering wind tunnel certifications for enclosed composite antenna radomes record a maximum survivable wind gust limit of 180 km/h for High-Latitude Coastal Tracking Base.
OPS-WIND-FS6：Structural engineering wind tunnel certifications for enclosed composite antenna radomes verify that Sub-Arctic Polar Radome Station has a maximum survivable wind gust limit of 240 km/h.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental winterization records and structural heating installations（CLIM）
information_points.content:
OPS-CLIM-P81：Records from the winterization engineering punch list indicate that Continental Plateau Telemetry Facility has an automated radome de-icing installation fully installed and commissioned on its radome enclosure membrane heating system.
OPS-CLIM-Y07：According to the winterization engineering punch list for the radome enclosure membrane heating system, Sub-Arctic Polar Radome Station has an automated radome de-icing installation fully installed and commissioned.
OPS-CLIM-F0H：Based on the winterization engineering punch list regarding the radome enclosure membrane heating system, High-Latitude Coastal Tracking Base does not have an automated radome de-icing installation installed or commissioned.
